headlines.description: The Atlanta Falcons have earned home-field advantage throughout the NFC playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons clinch No. 1 seed; Johnson breaks mark

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Dallas Cowboys

headlines.description: Garrett Hartley kicked a 20-yard field goal in overtime, and the New Orleans Saints damaged Dallas' playoff hopes with a 34-31 victory against the Cowboys on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys fall in OT, but still control playoff fate

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw for three touchdowns and ran for another, Ryan Grant scored twice and Randall Cobb set a single-season franchise record for net yardage Sunday as the Green Bay Packers routed the Tennessee Titans 55-7 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers paces surging Packers in rout of Titans

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw for 205 yards to break the single-season rookie record, and his touchdown pass to Reggie Wayne late in the fourth quarter Sunday gave the Indianapolis Colts a 20-13 win over the Kansas City Chiefs and a berth in the playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts clinch playoff berth as Luck sets record

headlines.description: Reggie Bush caught two touchdown passes and scored on a short run Sunday to help the Miami Dolphins beat the Bills 24-10.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bush scores 3 TDs as Dolphins beat rival Bills

events.name: San Diego Chargers at New York Jets

headlines.description: San Diego sacked Greg McElroy 11 times, ruining the Jets quarterback's first NFL start, and Rivers threw two touchdown passes in the Chargers' 27-17 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers sack Jets' McElroy 11 times in victory

headlines.description: Robert Griffin III threw two touchdown passes in his first game back from a knee injury, Kai Forbath set the NFL record for consecutive field goals to begin a career and the Redskins held on to beat the Eagles 27-20 Sunday for their sixth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins outlast lowly Eagles as RG III returns

headlines.description: Josh Brown kicked a 43-yard field goal with 4 seconds remaining to lift the Cincinnati Bengals over the Pittsburgh Steelers 13-10 on Sunday, sending the Bengals into the playoffs for a second straight season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals stun Steelers, secure postseason spot

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Sam Bradford tossed a pair of touchdown passes and rookie cornerback Janoris Jenkins scored his fourth TD of the season Sunday, helping the St. Louis Rams keep their hopes for a winning record alive with a 28-13 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradford helps Rams hit .500 with win at Bucs

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 171 yards and a touchdown and ran for 60 yards and another score, and the Carolina Panthers defeated the Oakland Raiders 17-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers limit Raiders in heated game

events.name: New England Patriots at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Tom Brady overcame a rough start by throwing two touchdown passes, and the playoff-bound New England Patriots held on to beat the woeful Jacksonville Jaguars 23-16 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady overcomes slow start as Patriots hold on

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson rushed for 86 yards, falling far short of the 2,000-yard mark, yet helping the Vikings keep their playoff hopes alive with a 23-6 upset of the Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings upend Texans to stay in playoff hunt

headlines.description: Denver won its 10th straight game Sunday as Peyton Manning threw three touchdown passes for the 72nd time of his career in a 34-12 victory over the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peyton guides Broncos to 10th straight victory

headlines.description: Chicago's defense scored two touchdowns and the Bears beat the Arizona Cardinals 28-13 on Sunday to keep their playoff hopes alive.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears handle Cards to keep alive playoff hopes

events.name: New York Giants at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw for 309 yards and two touchdowns, and the Baltimore Ravens defeated the New York Giants 33-14 Sunday to capture the AFC North title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flacco, Ravens roll Giants to win AFC North title

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw four touchdown passes to move into second place for TD passes by a rookie, Marshawn Lynch scored twice, and the Seahawks clinched a spot in the NFC playoffs with a 42-13 rout of San Francisco on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks clinch playoff spot with rout of 49ers
